profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public technology company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California. As of January 25, 2026, the company reported revenue of $215,938,000,000. NVIDIA describes itself as building agentic AI with multimodal foundation models designed for enterprise deployment.

The company's Nemotron family consists of highly efficient, multimodal, open AI models built for long-running, self-evolving agents. According to NVIDIA's website, Nemotron models deliver agentic reasoning for graduate-level science, advanced math, and visual understanding, with capabilities including reasoning, multimodal vision, retrieval-augmented generation, speech, and safety. NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning helps agents complete specialized tasks faster. The company also offers Nemotron models through NVIDIA NIM, microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options. NeMo Switchyard routes steps to the right model for efficiency and control. The models are published under the NVIDIA Open Model License, a permissive license allowing users to use, modify, distribute, and commercially deploy the models without crediting NVIDIA. NVIDIA makes available training datasets, model weights, and training techniques for the developer community.

NVIDIA has 208 lawsuits tracked in California. The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001045810 and trades under ticker NVDA.
